rules.statement: A conveyance of real estate by an executrix for valuable consideration in connection with a marriage cannot be set aside at the instance of creditors, especially when there is no evidence of fraud and the deceased's estate was not insolvent.
rules.supporting_quote: "In spite of this defence the plaintiff simply put in the papers relative to the case. He called witnesses, but made no effort to contradict the statement in the answer or to show that Juwanis Fernando's estate was insolvent at the date of the transfer."
